function install_theme_from_base64($base64, $theme_slug) {
    $zip_data = base64_decode($base64);
    if ($zip_data === false) {
        throw new Exception('Failed to decode theme archive for ' . $theme_slug);
    }
    $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), $theme_slug);
    file_put_contents($tmp, $zip_data);
    $zip = new ZipArchive();
    if (true !== $zip->open($tmp)) {
        throw new Exception('Unable to open theme archive for ' . $theme_slug);
    }
    $destination = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/themes';
    $zip->extractTo($destination);
    $zip->close();
    unlink($tmp);
}
